content.short: Puff Penthouse is MethLab's Mantle app for swapping and interacting with the PUFF token ecosystem.
content.description: Puff Penthouse is a Mantle application from MethLab focused on the PUFF token ecosystem. The app provides a wallet-connected interface where users can swap for PUFF and interact with the project's on-chain products through Mantle. It is positioned as the primary place for PUFF-related activity rather than a general-purpose exchange, giving the MethLab community a dedicated venue for token access and ecosystem participation. By running on Mantle, Puff Penthouse benefits from lower transaction costs and faster settlement for users moving in and out of PUFF positions.
